day_shape: 76 items: Russia-China veto US bid to extend UN Iran sanctions panel, House passes Graham Iran/Russia sanctions act, ISIS satellite report on Parchin/Taleghan-2 reconstruction, Iran expels Swedish diplomat, CENTCOM says 104 vessels redirected under blockade, UN fact-finding mission finds crimes against humanity in 2022 crackdown.

threads.label: UNSC veto and new US sanctions
threads.summary: Russia and China vetoed a US draft resolution to extend the mandate of the UN Iran sanctions committee's expert panel, per Al Jazeera and Iranian statements. The US House separately passed the Lindsey Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act of 2026, sending it to President Trump.

threads.label: Parchin reconstruction and Iran war reporting
threads.summary: An Institute for Science and International Security report cited satellite imagery showing Iran rapidly rebuilding the Taleghan 2 facility at Parchin, previously struck twice since 2024. A US Lead Inspector General report to Congress detailed the April–June 2026 US military campaign against Iran.

threads.label: US blockade, drones and Hormuz traffic
threads.summary: CENTCOM said USS George H.W. Bush operations have redirected 104 commercial vessels enforcing the US blockade of Iran, while Strait of Hormuz transits fell to three ships on Wednesday. The Jerusalem Post reported US officials saying Iran downed two MQ-1 drones; Sepah claimed via Defa Press it destroyed a 53rd MQ-9 over Qeshm.

threads.label: Iran-Europe diplomatic ruptures
threads.summary: Iran's foreign ministry expelled a Swedish diplomat within 48 hours in retaliation over restrictions on an Iranian diplomat in Stockholm, and summoned Germany's ambassador Axel Wilhelm Dittmann over statements by senior German officials. Both actions were confirmed via IRIB and Defa Press.

threads.label: Houthi threat and Red Sea shipping
threads.summary: A CAR report cited by the Jerusalem Post said Iranian support and foreign tech sustain Houthi missile, drone and maritime capabilities; Iranian sources told JPost China has privately asked Tehran to rein in the Houthis after a Saudi appeal. Defa Press and IRIB reported a tanker pursued by a small boat 75 nautical miles east of Aden, and Turkey condemned a Houthi drone attack on Saudi Arabia.

threads.label: IDF Gaza strikes and Oct 7 accountability
threads.summary: The IDF said strikes in Bureij and Gaza City killed Nukhba commander Muhammad Jamal Ahmad Eid and naval-array platoon commander Saleh Ziad Ibrahim Miqdad, plus Nukhba operative Sharif Shadi Ibrahim Labad in northern Gaza. Lt. Col. "Aleph," the Gaza Division intelligence officer on October 7, was formally dismissed; Shin Bet chief David Zini vowed global pursuit of October 7 perpetrators.

threads.label: Mahsa Amini anniversary, UN findings
threads.summary: A UN fact-finding mission concluded Iranian security forces committed crimes against humanity in the 2022 crackdown, and Amnesty International published a 1,000-page report naming 87 officials as "architects" of the repression. Iran International reported new abuse footage of a teenager by police, and Imola, Italy dedicated a green space to Mahsa Amini on the fourth anniversary of her death.
